folded.subject: do those
folded.object: commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death?

spans.text: [21] AR: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءًۭ مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ EN: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death?
Evil is that which they judge.

folded.id: follow it|and|do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know
folded.subject: follow it
folded.object: do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know

spans.text: [18] AR: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

folded.id: good things|and|preferred them over the worlds
folded.subject: good things

spans.text: [16] AR: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.

folded.id: had earned|will|not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides allah as allies
folded.subject: had earned
folded.object: not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies

spans.text: [10] AR: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ EN: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies.

folded.id: have|you|seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire
folded.subject: Have
folded.object: seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire

spans.text: [23] AR: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۢ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةًۭ فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ EN: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil?
So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

[25] AR: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

folded.id: indeed|in|that are signs for a people who give thought
folded.subject: Indeed
folded.object: that are signs for a people who give thought

spans.text: Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

[15] AR: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ EN: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self.

folded.id: it|is|allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by his command and that you may seek of his bounty
folded.subject: It
folded.object: Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty

spans.text: [12] AR: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ EN: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

[15] AR: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ EN: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self.
[9] AR: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ EN: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule.

[18] AR: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves.

folded.id: persists arrogantly|as|if he had not heard them
folded.subject: persists arrogantly
folded.object: if he had not heard them

spans.text: [8] AR: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ EN: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them.
So who will guide him after Allah?
[9] AR: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ EN: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule.
[2] AR: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ EN: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

folded.id: the revelation|of|the book is from allah
folded.subject: The revelation

spans.text: [2] AR: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ EN: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

[25] AR: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

[26] AR: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."

folded.id: then he|will|assemble you for the day of resurrection
folded.subject: then He
folded.object: assemble you for the Day of Resurrection

spans.text: [26] AR: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
Then will you not be reminded?

folded.id: then|in|what statement after allah and his verses will they believe?
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?

spans.text: Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?

[24] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ EN: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time."

folded.id: these are|the|verses of allah which we recite to you in truth
folded.subject: These are
folded.object: verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth

spans.text: [6] AR: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth.
And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.

folded.id: they|will|never avail you against allah at all
folded.subject: they
folded.object: never avail you against Allah at all

spans.text: [19] AR: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ EN: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all.
[11] AR: هَٰذَا هُدًۭى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ EN: This [Qur'an] is guidance.
[20] AR: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ EN: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
Those will have a humiliating punishment.

folded.id: to allah|belongs|the dominion of the heavens and the earth
folded.subject: to Allah
folded.object: the dominion of the heavens and the earth

spans.text: [27] AR: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ EN: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth.

folded.id: to those|who|have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of allah so that he may recompense a people for what they used to earn
folded.subject: to those
folded.object: have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn

spans.text: [14] AR: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ EN: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.

[24] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ EN: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time."

folded.id: who hears|the|verses of allah recited to him
folded.subject: Who hears
folded.object: verses of Allah recited to him

spans.text: [8] AR: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ EN: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them.

folded.id: within|the|heavens and earth are signs for the believers
folded.subject: within
folded.object: heavens and earth are signs for the believers

spans.text: [3] AR: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ EN: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.

folded.id: your lord|will|judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

spans.text: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
Then to your Lord you will be returned.
